 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Following an entertaining semifinals last week, the League of Legends World Championship finals is set for this Saturday in a winner-take-all event.
 The two teams set to face off is Gen.G and Bilibili Gaming, with both enjoying a near breeze of a penultimate round.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement SHOP: League of Legends World Championship tickets 
 Gen.G has yet to lose during Worlds; however, the team has been unable to finish first in international competition. On the other hand, Bilibili Gaming scored a win during the First Stand Tournament.
 Ready to watch the best E-sports players in the world face off for the ultimate prize? Tickets are still available and are selling quickly for over $1,000. Check out how to buy tickets below.
 Get last-minute League of Legends tickets 
 How much are League of Legends World Championship tickets?
 The League of Legends World Championship final featuring Gen.G and Bilibili Gaming is this Saturday, Nov. 14. As of publication, ticket prices start at $1,328.
